title: The three eunuchisms understood spiritually
english: On the three eunuchisms, understood spiritually. The earlier friends of the letter smoothed the third kind bodily to match the first two. But we, wanting to preserve the sequence of the three eunuchisms and approving the figurative interpretation of the third, will say the same kind of thing about the first two as well: figuratively, eunuchs are those who are inactive toward sexual pleasures. There are three differences among those who are inactive toward these things. Some are so from constitution, about whom he says, "There are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother's womb" (Matthew 19:12). Others are prompted by human reasoning. Still others, for the sake of the word of God, cut out the desiring part by deliberate intention for the kingdom of heaven. But one must not mutilate oneself bodily, for self-control is also a fruit of the Spirit.

title: Infants, the rich young man, and the workers' equal wage
english: "Then children were brought to him" up to the laying on of hands. Those who are infants in Christ and still nursing are always brought to Jesus: "I gave you milk to drink, not solid food" (1 Corinthians 3:2). After this the rich young man asks about eternal life: "If you want to be perfect, go, sell..." (Matthew 19:21). But he went away grieving because of his possessions. "A rich person will enter the kingdom of heaven with difficulty" (Matthew 19:23). He did not say it was impossible, but difficult: "It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle" (Matthew 19:24). And many who are first will be last, and the last first (Matthew 19:30). The parable of the workers in the vineyard shows those called at each hour receiving equal pay. Glory to Christ. Amen.
